name: Tank Battle
author: Jeremy Zeiber
description: A multiplayer-only tank battle: destroy the enemy tanks and try your luck with mystery packages - not all help. Arrows to move, buttons to shoot and stop.

descriptions.en: A multiplayer-only tank battle: destroy the enemy tanks and try your luck with mystery packages - not all help. Arrows to move, buttons to shoot and stop.
descriptions.it: Battaglia di carri armati solo multigiocatore: distruggi i carri nemici e tenta la sorte con i pacchi misteriosi, non tutti utili. Frecce per muoverti, pulsanti per sparare e fermarti.
